# R5 tables (generated by bench/r5/compare.py)

## 1. B1 / B2 / B3, phase 2 only, common cells (cell-level, paired)

18 cells: T1-latest5/canvas, T1-latest5/image, T10-type-send/canvas, T11-stale/canvas, T2-keystring-order/canvas, T2-keystring-order/image, T3-image-build/canvas, T3-image-build/dom, T3-image-build/image, T3-image-invoice/canvas, T3-image-invoice/dom, T3-image-invoice/image, T4-scroll-timestamp/canvas, T4-scroll-timestamp/image, T5-click-button/canvas, T5-click-button/image, T5-click-conv/canvas, T5-click-conv/image

Jobs are clustered in cells (the k=3 jobs of one cell are not independent) and every arm ran the same cells (paired design), so the unit of analysis is the cell. Per cell d = pass rate of B minus pass rate of A. Tests: exact paired sign-flip permutation test on the sum of d over cells (two-sided; cells with d = 0 contribute nothing), and the exact sign test on the cells with d != 0. CIs: percentile bootstrap over cells (10 000 resamples, seed 1), rate = passes / jobs in the resampled cells.

| arm | pass | cell-bootstrap 95% CI | naive Wilson 95% CI (jobs as independent; too narrow) | excluded (glyph) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | 42/54 (78%) | 61%–93% | 65%–87% | 0 |
| B2 | 50/54 (93%) | 80%–100% | 82%–97% | 0 |
| B3 | 53/54 (98%) | 94%–100% | 90%–100% | 0 |

| pair | cells | pass A | pass B | B − A (cell-bootstrap 95% CI) | cells B>A / B<A / tie | sign test p | permutation p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 vs B2 | 18 | 42/54 | 50/54 | +15% (+4% to +28%) | 6 / 0 / 12 | 0.0312 | 0.0312 |
| B1 vs B3 | 18 | 42/54 | 53/54 | +20% (+7% to +35%) | 7 / 0 / 11 | 0.0156 | 0.0156 |
| B2 vs B3 | 18 | 50/54 | 53/54 | +6% (+0% to +15%) | 2 / 0 / 16 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
